messages:
yasmin: Starting a short release window: publishing a TS+Py patch canary for 1.3.4. Plan: npm tag `patch-canary-3577771111`, test smoke, 5% internal routing. @sam handle publish, @maria_s draft note.

sam: Built packages, uploading now. Will tag `patch-canary-3577771111`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job started for @redwood/sdk@1.3.4-canary -> internal npm and pypi-staging. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3577771111/logs

maria_s: Drafted short note: "Canary patch for 1.3.4: bugfixes and telemetry tweaks. Dry-run only." Link: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/patch-3577771111

yasmin: Routing 5% now. Watch list: p50/p99 latency, error-rate, and token burn. Abort if error-rate >1%.

kevin: Seeing a small spike in error-rate (1.6%) on generate in ap-south-1 for canary. No other regions affected.

sam: Pausing routing. Removing dist-tag and unpublishing staging wheel. Running rollback commands.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback finished. `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk patch-canary-3577771111`. Traffic reverted to stable. Rollback CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3577771111/rollback :white_check_mark:

yasmin: Quick postmortem: regression due to telemetry hook change that mis-handled a timeout. Action items: revert hook, add unit test, re-run canary after fixes.

maria_s: Updating release notes to mark the canary as paused; stable unchanged. Will coordinate new dry-run once fix merges.

sam: PR opened to pin internal infra to 1.3.3 in case we need emergency workaround: https://github.com/redwood/internal-configs/pull/430

yasmin: Thanks all. Closing this window.
